posts.author: Litningman06
posts.body:
Hiya. I’m Litningman06, but feel free to call me Litningman, Litning, or Lit, or whatever else you can come up with.
I’m a pixel artist and composer. My musical style is inspired by that of the sound team that did music for Homestuck.
I used to use RPG Maker XP, but I switched to 2003 a while back.
My avatar is Tabitha, a character from my game Cause and Effect. She’s the general of a massive army, who often uses underhanded techniques to defeat her enemies.
I joined the forum because I had been browsing old topics for a long time prior, and I decided that I wanted to share my development experience with others!
You’ve probably already seen me around, but here’s my formal introduction. I’m really looking forward to discussing stuff with everyone!
